description: This file contains Rust source code for testing a JavaScript engine integration, including functions to load a random module, call a random range function, and a property-based test for the random range function.

methods.name: load_random_module
methods.description: Loads a JavaScript module with random bytes and returns the execution context and exports object.

methods.name: call_random_range
methods.description: Calls the JavaScript function 'randomRange' with min and max parameters and returns the result.
